name: Da Vinci

management.summary: Leasing staff frequently praised by name; some reports of rude staff and older (2017) very negative Yelp reviews. Palmer company-wide deposit-withholding lawsuit is a red flag for move-out. G.H. Palmer / GHP Management faced a 2019 class action alleging withheld security deposits via undocumented cleaning/repair charges; a proposed $10-12.5M settlement (2022) reportedly collapsed and headed toward trial (status unconfirmed).

maintenance.summary: Several say work orders handled quickly; gym described as old with broken machines, dirty hot tub.

cleanliness.summary: Common areas generally described as kept clean; hot tub/gym upkeep complaints.

noise.summary: Most common complaint: thin walls, Temple/Fremont traffic, adjacent fire station, loud weekend nights, pool noise late at night; Apr 2026 review on early-morning leaf blowers; RentCafe noise sub-score 3.0.

security.summary: Gated parking and listed 24-hr doorman; some package-theft complaints; area near 110 freeway/Civic Center.

pests.summary: Isolated roach reports (undated); no 2025-26 pest complaints found.

costs.summary: Rent viewed as high for one person; tandem parking, limited guest parking and towing of unstickered cars. Deposit-return risk given Palmer lawsuit.

dealbreakers: Noise for units facing Temple/Fremont; landlord's alleged security-deposit withholding (class action).
recent_trend: steady - 2025-26 reviews similar mix of staff praise and noise/parking complaints

name: The Piero

management.summary: Sharply split: leasing office called unreliable/inconsistent ('They lie, delay...') and 'worst property management' (Jul 2025), vs. 2025 student review calling management professional. G.H. Palmer / GHP Management faced a 2019 class action alleging withheld security deposits via undocumented cleaning/repair charges; a proposed $10-12.5M settlement (2022) reportedly collapsed and headed toward trial (status unconfirmed).

maintenance.summary: Maintenance techs often praised by name; history of long pool/gym closures (2023-24), older elevator outage of six months (2017-18).

cleanliness.summary: Some say gym/common areas kept clean; amenity upkeep inconsistent.

noise.summary: Little specific data; next to 110 freeway / downtown.

security.summary: 24-hr guard and fob access to elevators/stairs, but Jul 2025 break-in report with unresponsive management; 2023 package theft because security covers only one side.

pests.summary: Older (2017-19) roach reports in many units; nothing recent found.

costs.summary: Cheaper than many DTLA options; 2.5x income requirement; deposit-return risk given Palmer lawsuit.

dealbreakers: Recurring amenity closures and management responsiveness; recent break-in report; landlord deposit-withholding lawsuit.
recent_trend: declining - harshest complaints (break-in, unresponsive management) are from 2025
